extracted.name: Summertime Orange Cake with Icing
extracted.description: This is a summertime cake my family eats. It is refreshing and delicious. Simple and inexpensive. My family loves this and jokes around and calls it The Orange Miser Cake because literally nothing is wasted. Not even the peels 🍊 #HotDaysCoolIdeas
instruction_lines: In a large mixing bowl, cut up orange into very small pieces. Smaller, the better
Add eggs, sugar, flour, oil, baking powder and water.
Use an immersion blender to mix and blend everything very well into a smooth batter. (Tip: I will often use a standard blender to process the oranges before using the immersion blender).
Grease a 9x5 baking pan (or use parchment paper)
Bake in oven for 45-55 minutes (depending on your oven).
While the cake is baking, make the icing:
To a sauce pan, add powdered sugar, milk, orange juice and vanilla.
Using low heat, whisk together until your glaze is smooth. Remove from heat.
When cake is ready, allow to cool on a wire rack and drizzle icing all over it.
